correctness.rationale: The normalization is the variance of total depth divided by n², with n tending to infinity at each fixed α. Independently, the weighted mean depth updates by p_j(1+Z_j), where Z_j is the depth minus its conditional mean. The expected weighted variance updates by (1−p_j²)v_j+p_j(1−p_j). The weighted-mean martingale is L² convergent (for α≤−1, and also for α>−1, p_j=O(1/j) and v_j=O(log j)); the centered ordinary average depth has the same L² limit by Cesàro averaging and orthogonality of the Z_j. Set a=2^α, b=3^α, c=4^α. The j=3 term is ab²/[(1+a)²(1+a+b)²]=18^α−4·36^α+O(54^α). The j=4 term is c²[a+O(b+a²)]/(1+a+b+c)²=32^α+O(48^α). For α≤−2 the sums of k^α over k≥2 and j^(2α) over j≥5 are bounded by constants times 2^α and 5^(2α), respectively, by factoring out the first base and comparing with a fixed convergent power sum. Since v_j≤Σ_{k≥2}p_k, this gives O(50^α) for the whole remaining tail. The positivity and order of the resulting scales check out. The frozen exact n=6 checks and finite numerical truncations in verify_ultraold.py and verification_output.txt are corroboration only; the script was inspected, not run.
